diffLines.text: +After running `wxt prepare` (or starting `wxt dev`), WXT generates `.wxt/entrypoints.ts` with one exported constant per entrypoint:
diffLines.html: +After running `wxt prepare` (or starting `wxt dev`), WXT generates `.wxt/entrypoints.ts` with one exported constant per entrypoint:
+export const ENTRYPOINT_POPUP = 'popup.html';
+export const ENTRYPOINT_BACKGROUND = 'background.js';
+export const ENTRYPOINT_OVERLAY = 'content-scripts/overlay.js';
+export const ENTRYPOINT_OVERLAY_CSS = 'content-scripts/overlay.css';

+Import them via the `#entrypoints` alias:

diffLines.text: +If you later rename `entrypoints/overlay.content.ts` to `entrypoints/badge.content.ts`, the import breaks at compile time instead of at runtime.
diffLines.html: +If you later rename `entrypoints/overlay.content.ts` to `entrypoints/badge.content.ts`, the import breaks at compile time instead of at runtime.

diffLines.text: +By default the constant name comes from the entrypoint filename. To give an entrypoint a stable identifier that survives renames, set `ref` in its options:
diffLines.html: +By default the constant name comes from the entrypoint filename. To give an entrypoint a stable identifier that survives renames, set `ref` in its options:
+export const ENTRYPOINT_OVERLAY = 'content-scripts/overlay.js';

diffLines.text: +Rename the source file to `entrypoints/badge.content.ts` and the constant stays `ENTRYPOINT_OVERLAY`.
diffLines.html: +Rename the source file to `entrypoints/badge.content.ts` and the constant stays `ENTRYPOINT_OVERLAY`.

diffLines.text: +When a content script has a sibling stylesheet that WXT picks up as a `content-script-style` entrypoint (file-pair like `entrypoints/overlay.content.ts` + `entrypoints/overlay.content.css`, or directory-form `entrypoints/overlay.content/index.ts` + `entrypoints/overlay.content/*.css`), a sibling `_CSS` constant is generated automatically:
diffLines.html: +When a content script has a sibling stylesheet that WXT picks up as a `content-script-style` entrypoint (file-pair like `entrypoints/overlay.content.ts` + `entrypoints/overlay.content.css`, or directory-form `entrypoints/overlay.content/index.ts` + `entrypoints/overlay.content/*.css`), a sibling `_CSS` constant is generated automatically:
+export const ENTRYPOINT_OVERLAY = 'content-scripts/overlay.js';
+export const ENTRYPOINT_OVERLAY_CSS = 'content-scripts/overlay.css';

diffLines.text: +Pass both to `registerContentScripts`. Content scripts with no CSS get only the `.js` constant.
diffLines.html: +Pass both to `registerContentScripts`. Content scripts with no CSS get only the `.js` constant.
+| Source | Generated constant |
+| `entrypoints/popup.html` | `ENTRYPOINT_POPUP` |
+| `entrypoints/background.ts` | `ENTRYPOINT_BACKGROUND` |
+| `entrypoints/overlay.content.ts` | `ENTRYPOINT_OVERLAY` |
+| `entrypoints/my-page.html` | `ENTRYPOINT_MY_PAGE` |
+| `defineContentScript({ ref: 'CUSTOM' })` | `ENTRYPOINT_CUSTOM` |
+Non-alphanumeric characters collapse into `_`.

diffLines.text: +Dynamic APIs like `browser.scripting.registerContentScripts()` and `browser.runtime.getURL()` need the post-bundle path as a string — and a hardcoded `'content-scripts/overlay.js'` keeps compiling after you rename the source file, only to fail at runtime. With this module the path is a constant the type-checker sees, so a rename forces an import update.
diffLines.html: +Dynamic APIs like `browser.scripting.registerContentScripts()` and `browser.runtime.getURL()` need the post-bundle path as a string — and a hardcoded `'content-scripts/overlay.js'` keeps compiling after you rename the source file, only to fail at runtime. With this module the path is a constant the type-checker sees, so a rename forces an import update.
